speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and improving with rest is highly characteristic of a neuromuscular junction disorder. Have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or breathing, and do you experience muscle pain or stiffness? speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. Given your description of symptoms worsening with activity and improving with rest, along with the characteristic double vision and limb weakness, this is the most likely diagnosis. The antibody and nerve conduction tests I ordered will confirm this.
